# Shadow Strike (delivery model)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** Thunder Spike
- **Mechanic tags:** shotgun, damage-pool, trigger
- **Backlog:** `SHADOW-01` (see `docs/INGAME_VERIFICATION_BACKLOG.md`)

## Derived / confirmed formula

Help DB `shadow-strike`: "Shadows deal the same amount of damage as the player, but if multiple Shadows hit the same enemy at the same time, the damage from each Shadow beyond the first one will additionally -70%." master_glossary 136 "Phantom" corroborates: "Multiple Shadows can attack the same target, and the Shadows' Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 70%. Shadow damage and character damage are independent of each other." Modeled as a delivery multiplier `shadow_mult = 1 + (1 + 0.30·(N−1))·(1 + Σ shadow_dmg_additional)` for N≥1 shadows (N=0 → mult 1.0, i.e. player hit only), where the `1 +` outer term is the player's own hit and the shadow term assumes all N shadows land on the SAME single target (first shadow full damage, each further shadow additionally −70% → contributes only 30%). Despised Shadow's "33% chance to gain +K Shadows when using the Shadow Strike skill" (exact quote, `_legendary_gear.json` `despised_shadow`) is folded in as a per-cast expected value: `shadow_mult = (1−p)·f(N_base) + p·f(N_base+k)`, `f(N)` as above (owner-approved EV mix, 2026-07-15).

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Two bugs fixed during implementation (see `.wolf/buglog.json`): `shadow-dmg-additional-generic-pool-leak` (`SHADOW_DMG_ADDITIONAL` had no `tags`, leaking into the generic `_HIT_ADDITIONAL_STATS` pool and buffing ALL hit damage regardless of Shadow Strike — fixed via a `_SHADOW_SCOPED_ADDITIONAL` frozenset) and `shadow-quantity-fuzzy-collision` (the new stat's display name "Shadow Chance Quantity" tied the fuzzy gear-text resolver against "Max Shadow Quantity" — renamed to "Shadow Chance Bonus Count"). Re-confirmed the pool-leak fix holds with real gear: attaching the same gear to `chain_lightning` (not a Shadow Strike skill) does NOT consume `shadow_dmg_additional`.

**Explicitly NYI** (owner decisions 2026-07-15, listed so they're never silently dropped):
- **Frantic Shadow** "X% chance to gain +Y% Attack Speed for Z s when Shadows hit enemies" — needs shadow-hit-count expected-value modeling (unlock for this + the next item).
- **Numb Magnificent** "30% chance to inflict 1 stack of Numbed on enemies within a 10m radius when the supported skill's Shadows hit an enemy" — same reason.
- **Tracking Area** entirely unmodeled: Thunder Spike's "100% of Skill Area increase/decrease also applied to Shadows' Tracking Area, up to 100%", the dedicated `+% Shadow(s) Tracking Area` stat family, Dual Kismet: Ghost Bee ("+50% Shadow Tracking Area +50% Shadow Strike Skill Area"), and Charging Warcry's "+20% Tracking Area for Shadow Strike Skills while the skill lasts". No AoE/targeting model exists in the engine to consume any of this.
- **Charging Warcry** "Shadow Strike Skills gain 4% additional damage and Ailment Damage for every enemy affected by this skill" — per-enemy-affected scaling unmodeled (no enemy-count model for this skill's own AoE).
- **Frost Spike / Double Thrusts** are unregistered in `skill_resolver._REGISTRY` — Thunder Spike is the only Shadow Strike skill live in v1. Detection is tag-driven (the "Shadow Strike" skill_tag), so these light up automatically once registered — no shadow-strike-specific code needed when that happens.

See `data/verification/thunder-spike.json` for the skill-specific model (WAD, intrinsic conversion, inherent Numbed, Rumbling Thunder).

## Implementation (engine model)

`backend/engine/offense.py::_shadow_multiplier` (kwarg `shadow=` on `calculate_offense`), folded into `_delivery` alongside cast/tangle/spell-burst/multistrike multipliers. Detection is data-driven off the "Shadow Strike" skill tag (NOT hardcoded to `thunder_spike`) in `backend/engine/compute.py::_offense_for_slot`, which reads `max_shadow_quantity_flat` plus the two chance stats (`Stat.SHADOW_CHANCE_PCT`, `Stat.SHADOW_CHANCE_QUANTITY_FLAT` — kept SEPARATE from the base count, not collapsed to an EV count, because `_shadow_multiplier` is nonlinear in N) from the slot-materialized source. Despised Shadow's two-literal-number chance line gets a bespoke `mod_parser.py` regex branch (can't use the single-value `_EXPRESSION_STAT_OVERRIDES` dict). Shadow sources wired: **Haunt** (support, +2 Shadow Quantity, slot-local), **Frantic Shadow** (legendary, Shadow Quantity +1), craft-base compound "Shadow Quantity +N +(A–B)% additional Shadow Damage" (`_craft_base_types.json` Ultimate Suffix, one glued line with no comma/"and" separator — bespoke regex in `mod_parser.py`), **Ronin talent `ronin_c6_r2`** (+1, resolves via `core_talent_resolver._strip_max_div`), and **Despised Shadow** itself (chance + "+(14–16)% additional Shadow Damage", corroded variant +(20–24)%, k=4 shadows). End-to-end gear verification (real `unresolved_texts`, Despised Shadow + Frantic Shadow both equipped): `shadow_count=1`, `shadow_chance_pct=0.33`, `shadow_chance_quantity=3.0`, `shadow_dmg_additional=0.15`, `shadow_mult=2.49155` — matches the hand-computed EV mix exactly.
